question: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\) and \(\angle A=30^\circ\). Which of the following equations is correct?
solution: The leg opposite the \(30^\circ\) angle \(\angle A\) is \(BC\), so \(BC\) equals half the hypotenuse \(AB\). Thus, \(AB=2BC\).
